skill_name: Describe the differences between a prokaryotic cell and an eukaryotic cell.
workflow: The main differences between prokaryotic cells and eukaryotic cells are that prokaryotic cells are much simpler in their structure and organization. Prokaryotic cells lack a nucleus, instead having their genetic material dispersed throughout the cytoplasm. Eukaryotic cells, on the other hand, possess a membrane-bound nucleus which contains all of the genetic material of the cell.
